content.title: Portland Trail Blazers vs Denver Nuggets Live Stream: How to Watch NBA
content.text: The Denver Nuggets go for the 3-1 season series win over the Portland Trail Blazers on Monday. The Denver Nuggets go for their ninth straight victory when they host the Portland Trail Blazers in the season-series finale on Monday. The Nuggets are getting healthy and hot at exactly the right time, right before the playoffs. Portland is also playing well lately, having won its fourth straight game. Portland is trying to improve its standing for the Play-In. The Trail Blazers have clinched a Play-In spot in a very competitive Western Conference. Portland is 40-38 on the season, which is the exact record of the eight seed LA Clippers. Denver has the exact same 50-28 record as the third place Los Angeles Lakers. Denver leads this series 2-1 over Portland after a 128-112 home victory on March 23. Nikola Jokic put up his 35th triple-double of the season with 22 points, 14 rebounds and 14 assists, and Jamal Murray added 22 points. The Nuggets have won nine of their last 10 games, but the Houston Rockets are only a game back of Denver. Denver is coming off one of its best and most thrilling wins of the season on Saturday, beating the San Antonio Spurs 136-134 in overtime. The win tied the season series 2-2 in the finale. Jokic outdueled MVP candidate Victor Wembanyama (34 points), scoring 40 points, 13 assists and eight rebounds to help end San Antonio’s 11-game winning streak. Christian Braun added 21 points, while Murray finished with 15 points and 10 assists. Denver trailed by as much as 13 in the second quarter, and the Spurs held a double-digit lead in the fourth. Denver rallied tremendously, holding the Spurs to just 33 percent shooting late in the game and outscored San Antonio 40-27 in the last 14 minutes. Portland is coming off its third straight win, beating the New Orleans Pelicans on Thursday, 118-106. The Trail Blazers have now won five of their last six games. Jrue Holiday led the club with 27 points and an impressive seven three-pointers.
